description: This file defines functions and types for normalizing and processing outbound reply payloads, including merging media URLs, filtering payloads, and formatting logs. It interacts with reply payloads, reply directives, and interactive reply data.

methods.name: mergeMediaUrls
methods.description: Merges multiple lists of media URLs into a unique list, trimming and removing duplicates.

methods.name: normalizeReplyPayloadsForDelivery
methods.description: Normalizes reply payloads by parsing directives, merging media URLs, and filtering non-renderable or silent payloads.

methods.name: normalizeOutboundPayloads
methods.description: Converts reply payloads into normalized outbound payloads with proper structure and content.

methods.name: normalizeOutboundPayloadsForJson
methods.description: Converts reply payloads into JSON-ready outbound payloads.

methods.name: formatOutboundPayloadLog
methods.description: Formats a payload into a string log, including text and media URLs.
